```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Example: your matrices should be binary (0/1 or similar)
# adj_matrix: inferred
# true_graph_test: ground truth

# Identify FP and FN
fp_matrix <- (adj_matrix == 1) & (true_graph_test == 0)
fn_matrix <- (adj_matrix == 0) & (true_graph_test == 1)

# Create a label matrix: 0 = correct, 1 = FP, 2 = FN
label_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(adj_matrix), ncol = ncol(adj_matrix))
label_matrix[fp_matrix] <- 1
label_matrix[fn_matrix] <- 2

# Melt for ggplot
melted <- melt(label_matrix)
colnames(melted) <- c("From", "To", "Type")

# Plot
ggplot(melted, aes(x = To, y = From, fill = factor(Type))) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "white", "1" = "red", "2" = "blue"),
                    labels = c("Correct", "False Positive", "False Negative"),
                    name = "Edge Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  coord_fixed()
```

# test how accuracy and recall changing over # of experiments


```{r}
true_graph_test <- sample_directed_graph(250, 0, sparsity = 0.2)

experiment_counts <- seq(65, 165, by = 20)
results_exp1 <- list()

for (num_exp in experiment_counts) {
  my_exp <- fair_ordered(250, num_exp, 8)
  exp_design <- my_exp$experiment_matrix
  colnames(exp_design) <- rownames(true_graph_test)

  exp_results <- compute_edge_reachability_matrix(exp_design, true_graph_test)
  lp_data <- prepare_edge_lp_matrices(exp_design, exp_results)

  model <- build_highs_model(lp_data)
  result <- ROI_solve(model, solver = "highs")
  solution_mat <- matrix(solution(result), 
                         nrow = ncol(exp_design), 
                         ncol = ncol(exp_results),
                         dimnames = list(colnames(exp_design), colnames(exp_results)))

  res_hard <- calculate_precision_recall_hard(true_graph_test, solution_mat)
  res_zero <- calculate_precision_recall_zero(true_graph_test, solution_mat)
  res_soft <- calculate_precision_recall_soft(true_graph_test, solution_mat)

  results_exp1[[as.character(num_exp)]] <- data.frame(
    experiments = num_exp,
    method = rep(c("hard", "zero", "soft"), each = 2),
    metric = rep(c("precision", "recall"), 3),
    value = c(res_hard$precision, res_hard$recall,
              res_zero$precision, res_zero$recall,
              res_soft$precision, res_soft$recall)
  )
}

df_exp1 <- bind_rows(results_exp1)
write.csv(df_exp1, "/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/results/highs_results_test/precision_recall_vs_experiments_N250_sp0.2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
png("/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/results/highs_results_test/precision_recall_vs_experiments_N250_sp0.2.png",width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
ggplot(df_exp1, aes(x = experiments, y = value, color = method, linetype = metric)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Precision & Recall vs. #Experiments (Fixed Graph)",
       y = "Score") +
  theme_minimal()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
sparsities <- c(0.2, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05, 0.01)
num_exp <- 65
 my_exp <- fair_ordered(250, num_exp, 8)
results_exp2_sparsity_based <- list()
results_exp2_zero_based <- list()

for (s in sparsities) {
  tmp_list <- replicate(5, {
    true_graph_test <- sample_directed_graph(250, 0, sparsity = s)
    exp_design <- my_exp$experiment_matrix
    colnames(exp_design) <- rownames(true_graph_test)
    exp_results <- compute_edge_reachability_matrix(exp_design, true_graph_test)
    num_zeros <- sum(exp_results == 0)

    lp_data <- prepare_edge_lp_matrices(exp_design, exp_results)
    lp_data$f.dir <- gsub("^=$", "==", lp_data$f.dir)

    model <- build_highs_model(lp_data)
    result <- ROI_solve(model, solver = "highs")
    solution_mat <- matrix(solution(result), 
                           nrow = ncol(exp_design), 
                           ncol = ncol(exp_results),
                           dimnames = list(colnames(exp_design), colnames(exp_results)))

    list(
      hard = calculate_precision_recall_hard(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      zero = calculate_precision_recall_zero(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      soft = calculate_precision_recall_soft(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      num_zeros = num_zeros
    )
  }, simplify = FALSE)


  average_metrics <- function(type, metric) {
    mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x[[type]][[metric]]))
  }

  avg_zero_count <- mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x$num_zeros))


  results_exp2_sparsity_based[[as.character(s)]] <- data.frame(
    sparsity = s,
    method = rep(c("hard", "zero", "soft"), each = 2),
    metric = rep(c("precision", "recall"), 3),
    value = c(
      average_metrics("hard", "precision"), average_metrics("hard", "recall"),
      average_metrics("zero", "precision"), average_metrics("zero", "recall"),
      average_metrics("soft", "precision"), average_metrics("soft", "recall")
    )
  )


  results_exp2_zero_based[[as.character(s)]] <- data.frame(
    zero_count = avg_zero_count,
    method = rep(c("hard", "zero", "soft"), each = 2),
    metric = rep(c("precision", "recall"), 3),
    value = c(
      average_metrics("hard", "precision"), average_metrics("hard", "recall"),
      average_metrics("zero", "precision"), average_metrics("zero", "recall"),
      average_metrics("soft", "precision"), average_metrics("soft", "recall")
    )
  )
  gc()
}


df_exp2_sparsity <- bind_rows(results_exp2_sparsity_based)
df_exp2_zero <- bind_rows(results_exp2_zero_based)

write.csv(df_exp2_sparsity, "/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/results/highs_results_test/precision_recall_vs_sparsity_N250.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(df_exp2_zero, "/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/results/highs_results_test/precision_recall_vs_negative_number_N250.csv", row.names = FALSE)


png("/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/results/highs_results_test/precision_recall_vs_sparsity_N250.png",width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
ggplot(df_exp2_sparsity, aes(x = sparsity, y = value, color = method, linetype = metric)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Precision & Recall vs. Sparsity (Fixed #Experiments)",
       y = "Metrics") +
  theme_minimal()
dev.off()

png("/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/results/highs_results_test/precision_recall_vs_negative_number_N250.png",width = 2000,height = 1600)
ggplot(df_exp2_zero, aes(x = zero_count, y = value, color = method, linetype = metric)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Precision & Recall vs. # of negative test outcomes",
       x = "#Zeros in exp_results", y = "Score") +
  theme_minimal()
dev.off()




```

```{r}
seed = 123
rates <- c(0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5)
num_exp <- 65
my_exp <- fair_ordered(250, num_exp, 8)
results_exp2_exp_based <- list()

for (rate in rates) {
    tmp_list <- lapply(0:4, function(i) {
    set.seed(123 + i)  # Set seed for reproducibility
    
    true_graph_test <- sample_graph_exponential_degree(250, 0, rate = rate)
    sparsity <- calculate_sparsity(true_graph_test)
    
    exp_design <- my_exp$experiment_matrix
    colnames(exp_design) <- rownames(true_graph_test)
    exp_results <- compute_edge_reachability_matrix(exp_design, true_graph_test)
    num_zeros <- sum(exp_results == 0)

    lp_data <- prepare_edge_lp_matrices(exp_design, exp_results)
    lp_data$f.dir <- gsub("^=$", "==", lp_data$f.dir)

    model <- build_highs_model(lp_data)
    result <- ROI_solve(model, solver = "highs")
    solution_mat <- matrix(solution(result), 
                           nrow = ncol(exp_design), 
                           ncol = ncol(exp_results),
                           dimnames = list(colnames(exp_design), colnames(exp_results)))

    list(
      hard = calculate_precision_recall_hard(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      zero = calculate_precision_recall_zero(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      soft = calculate_precision_recall_soft(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      num_zeros = num_zeros,
      sparsity = sparsity
    )
  })
  average_metrics <- function(type, metric) {
    mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x[[type]][[metric]]))
  }
  avg_zero_count <- mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x$num_zeros))
  avg_sparsity <- mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x$sparsity))

  results_exp2_exp_based[[as.character(rate)]] <- data.frame(
    rate = rate,
    method = rep(c("hard", "zero", "soft"), each = 2),
    metric = rep(c("precision", "recall"), 3),
    value = c(
      average_metrics("hard", "precision"), average_metrics("hard", "recall"),
      average_metrics("zero", "precision"), average_metrics("zero", "recall"),
      average_metrics("soft", "precision"), average_metrics("soft", "recall")
    ),
    zero_count = avg_zero_count,
    avg_sparsity = avg_sparsity
  )
  gc()
}

df_exp2_exp <- bind_rows(results_exp2_exp_based)
write.csv(df_exp2_exp, "/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/results/highs_results_test/precision_recall_vs_exponential_rate.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# test baseline
```{r}
sparsities <- c(0.2, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05, 0.01)
num_exp <- 100
my_exp <- fair_ordered(100, num_exp, 1)
results_exp2_sparsity_based <- list()
results_exp2_zero_based <- list()

for (s in sparsities) {
  tmp_list <- replicate(5, {
    true_graph_test <- sample_directed_graph(100, 0, sparsity = s)
    exp_design <- my_exp$experiment_matrix
    colnames(exp_design) <- rownames(true_graph_test)
    exp_results <- compute_edge_reachability_matrix(exp_design, true_graph_test)
    num_zeros <- sum(exp_results == 0)

    lp_data <- prepare_edge_lp_matrices(exp_design, exp_results)
    lp_data$f.dir <- gsub("^=$", "==", lp_data$f.dir)

    model <- build_highs_model(lp_data)
    result <- ROI_solve(model, solver = "highs")
    solution_mat <- matrix(solution(result), 
                           nrow = ncol(exp_design), 
                           ncol = ncol(exp_results),
                           dimnames = list(colnames(exp_design), colnames(exp_results)))

    list(
      hard = calculate_precision_recall_hard(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      zero = calculate_precision_recall_zero(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      soft = calculate_precision_recall_soft(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
      num_zeros = num_zeros
    )
  }, simplify = FALSE)


  average_metrics <- function(type, metric) {
    mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x[[type]][[metric]]))
  }

  avg_zero_count <- mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x$num_zeros))


  results_exp2_sparsity_based[[as.character(s)]] <- data.frame(
    sparsity = s,
    method = rep(c("hard", "zero", "soft"), each = 2),
    metric = rep(c("precision", "recall"), 3),
    value = c(
      average_metrics("hard", "precision"), average_metrics("hard", "recall"),
      average_metrics("zero", "precision"), average_metrics("zero", "recall"),
      average_metrics("soft", "precision"), average_metrics("soft", "recall")
    )
  )


  results_exp2_zero_based[[as.character(s)]] <- data.frame(
    zero_count = avg_zero_count,
    method = rep(c("hard", "zero", "soft"), each = 2),
    metric = rep(c("precision", "recall"), 3),
    value = c(
      average_metrics("hard", "precision"), average_metrics("hard", "recall"),
      average_metrics("zero", "precision"), average_metrics("zero", "recall"),
      average_metrics("soft", "precision"), average_metrics("soft", "recall")
    )
  )
  gc()
}
```

```{r}
N <- 100

k <- 1

results_exp2_subset <- list()

for (n_subset in subset_sizes) {
  seed_list <- c(101, 202, 303, 404, 505)

tmp_list <- lapply(seed_list, function(seed_i) {
  set.seed(seed_i)

  # Random subset of nodes
  selected_nodes <- sort(sample(seq_len(N), n_subset, replace = FALSE))
  
  # Create experiment design for selected subset
  my_exp <- fair_ordered(n_subset, n_subset, 1)
  exp_design_subset <- my_exp$experiment_matrix
  colnames(exp_design_subset) <- paste0("V", selected_nodes)

  # Expand to full 100-node design
  exp_design <- matrix(0, nrow = n_subset, ncol = N)
  colnames(exp_design) <- paste0("V", seq_len(N))
  rownames(exp_design) <- rownames(exp_design_subset)

  for (i in seq_len(n_subset)) {
    perturbed_node <- which(exp_design_subset[i, ] == 1)
    exp_design[i, selected_nodes[perturbed_node]] <- 1
  }

  # Downstream analysis
  print(which(exp_design == 1))
  colnames(exp_design) <- colnames(true_graph_test)
  exp_results <- compute_edge_reachability_matrix(exp_design, true_graph_test)
  num_zeros <- sum(exp_results == 0)

  lp_data <- prepare_edge_lp_matrices(exp_design, exp_results)
  lp_data$f.dir <- gsub("^=$", "==", lp_data$f.dir)
  model <- build_highs_model(lp_data)
  result <- ROI_solve(model, solver = "highs")

  solution_mat <- matrix(solution(result), 
                         nrow = ncol(exp_design), 
                         ncol = ncol(exp_results),
                         dimnames = list(colnames(exp_design), colnames(exp_results)))

  list(
    seed = seed_i,
    hard = calculate_precision_recall_hard(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
    zero = calculate_precision_recall_zero(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
    soft = calculate_precision_recall_soft(true_graph_test, solution_mat),
    num_zeros = num_zeros
  )
})

  average_metrics <- function(type, metric) {
    mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x[[type]][[metric]]))
  }

  avg_zero_count <- mean(sapply(tmp_list, function(x) x$num_zeros))

  results_exp2_subset[[as.character(n_subset)]] <- data.frame(
    num_subset_nodes = n_subset,
    method = rep(c("hard", "zero", "soft"), each = 2),
    metric = rep(c("precision", "recall"), 3),
    value = c(
      average_metrics("hard", "precision"), average_metrics("hard", "recall"),
      average_metrics("zero", "precision"), average_metrics("zero", "recall"),
      average_metrics("soft", "precision"), average_metrics("soft", "recall")
    ),
    zero_count = avg_zero_count
  )

  gc()
}
```

```{r}
compute_precision_recall_DD <- function(pred_matrix, true_matrix) {
  stopifnot(all(dim(pred_matrix) == dim(true_matrix)))

  # Flatten
  pred <- as.vector(pred_matrix)
  truth <- as.vector(true_matrix)

  # ------ Precision ------
  # Precision: Only count positions where pred is 0 or 1 (exclude NA, 9999)
  pred_valid_mask <- !is.na(pred) & pred != 9999 & !is.na(truth)
  pred_vals <- pred[pred_valid_mask]
  truth_vals <- truth[pred_valid_mask]

  TP <- sum(pred_vals == 1 & truth_vals == 1)
  FP <- sum(pred_vals == 1 & truth_vals == 0)

  precision <- if ((TP + FP) > 0) TP / (TP + FP) else NA

  # ------ Recall ------
  # Recall: for all true edges, check if they were correctly predicted (even NA is failure)
  true_edge_mask <- !is.na(truth) & truth == 1
  true_edge_pred <- pred[true_edge_mask]

  TP_recall <- sum(true_edge_pred == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  FN <- sum(is.na(true_edge_pred) | true_edge_pred == 0 | true_edge_pred == 9999)

  recall <- if ((TP_recall + FN) > 0) TP_recall / (TP_recall + FN) else NA

  return(list(
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    TP = TP,
    FP = FP,
    FN = FN
  ))
}
```

```{r}

generate_baseline_design <- function(regulators, max_size = 8) {
  shuffled <- sample(regulators)
  n <- length(shuffled)

  # Full experiment sets (chunks of size max_size)
  n_full <- floor(n / max_size)
  full_chunks <- split(shuffled[1:(n_full * max_size)],
                       rep(1:n_full, each = max_size))

  # Remaining regulators (singleton experiments)
  leftovers <- shuffled[(n_full * max_size + 1):n]

  design_list <- c(full_chunks, as.list(leftovers))

  # Convert to binary matrix
  all_genes <- unique(unlist(design_list))
  exp_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(design_list), ncol = length(all_genes),
                    dimnames = list(paste0("exp", seq_along(design_list)), all_genes))

  for (i in seq_along(design_list)) {
    exp_mat[i, design_list[[i]]] <- 1
  }

  return(exp_mat)
}

```

```{r}
generate_baseline_design <- function(regulators, all_regulators, max_size = 8) {
  # ✅ Assert all regulators are valid
  if (!all(regulators %in% all_regulators)) {
    missing <- setdiff(regulators, all_regulators)
    stop("The following regulators are not in all_regulators:\n",
         paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  shuffled <- sample(regulators)
  n <- length(shuffled)

  n_full <- floor(n / max_size)
  full_chunks <- split(shuffled[1:(n_full * max_size)],
                       rep(1:n_full, each = max_size))

  # Proper handling when there's no leftover
  if (n_full * max_size < n) {
    leftovers <- shuffled[(n_full * max_size + 1):n]
    design_list <- c(full_chunks, as.list(leftovers))
  } else {
    design_list <- full_chunks
  }

  # Build binary matrix with consistent columns
  exp_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(design_list), ncol = length(all_regulators),
                    dimnames = list(paste0("exp", seq_along(design_list)), all_regulators))

  for (i in seq_along(design_list)) {
    genes <- design_list[[i]]
    if (length(genes) > 0) {
      exp_mat[i, genes] <- 1
    }
  }

  return(exp_mat)
}

```

# experiments added for DD theories

```{r}
true_graph_test <- sample_directed_graph(250, 0, sparsity = 0.2)

experiment_counts <- seq(65, 165, by = 20)
results_exp1 <- list()

for (num_exp in experiment_counts) {
  my_exp <- fair_ordered(250, num_exp, 8)
  exp_design <- my_exp$experiment_matrix
  colnames(exp_design) <- rownames(true_graph_test)

  exp_results <- compute_edge_reachability_matrix(exp_design, true_graph_test)
  adj_DD <- infer_edges_definite(exp_design, exp_results)

  metrics <- compute_precision_recall_DD(adj_DD, true_graph_test)
  F1 <- if (!is.na(metrics$precision) && !is.na(metrics$recall) &&
              (metrics$precision + metrics$recall) > 0) {
    2 * metrics$precision * metrics$recall / (metrics$precision + metrics$recall)
  } else NA

  results_exp1[[as.character(num_exp)]] <- data.frame(
    experiments = num_exp,
    metric = c("precision", "recall", "F1"),
    value = c(metrics$precision, metrics$recall, F1)
  )
}

df_exp1 <- bind_rows(results_exp1)
out_csv <- "/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd-code/code/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/DD_simu/lower_bound_identify/precision_recall_F1_vs_experiments_N250_sp0.2.csv"
write.csv(df_exp1, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

# 理论下界
T_bound <- calculate_T_bound(sum(true_graph_test == 1), 250, 0, 250, 8)

out_png <- "/nfs/turbo/umms-welchjd-code/code/wzqian/Casualformer/theory/DD_simu/lower_bound_identify/precision_recall_F1_vs_experiments_N250_sp0.2.png"
png(out_png, width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
ggplot(df_exp1, aes(x = experiments, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = T_bound, size = 2) +
  annotate("text", x = T_bound, y = max(df_exp1$value, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.2,
           label = paste("Lower Bound =", T_bound, 
                         ", Sparsity =", calculate_sparsity(true_graph_test)),
           vjust = -0.5, angle = 90, hjust = -0.1) +
  labs(title = "Precision, Recall & F1 vs. #Experiments (DD alg, Fixed Graph)",
       y = "Score") +
  theme_minimal()
dev.off()

```
